---
title: "Database Downloads"
subtitle: Download links for the five slim SQLite databases
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
th { white-space: nowrap; }
```

Each source's slim database is published as an asset on the GitHub release of its
pilot repository. All five share the common [DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd)
— the same seven tables, differing only in a few source-specific columns.

## Available databases

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(knitr)

rel <- "https://github.com/seafood-hazards"

database_tbl <- tribble(
  ~Source,      ~File,                  ~Download,
  "Mareano",    "mareano_slim.sqlite",   sprintf("<a href='%s/mareano-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.16/mareano_slim.sqlite'>Download</a>", rel),
  "Vannmiljø",  "vannmiljo_slim.sqlite", sprintf("<a href='%s/vannmiljo-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.16/vannmiljo_slim.sqlite'>Download</a>", rel),
  "ICES-DOME",  "ices_dome_slim.sqlite", sprintf("<a href='%s/ices-dome-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.17/ices_dome_slim.sqlite'>Download</a>", rel),
  "MUDAB",      "mudab_slim.sqlite",     sprintf("<a href='%s/mudab-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.4/mudab_slim.sqlite'>Download</a>", rel),
  "4Demon",     "4demon_slim.sqlite",    sprintf("<a href='%s/4demon-pilot/releases/download/v0.1.0/4demon_slim.sqlite'>Download</a>", rel)
)

kable(database_tbl, escape = FALSE)
```

::: {.callout-note}
Each file is a self-contained SQLite database. See the
[DB Schema (Slim)](./db-schema-slim.qmd) page for the table definitions and the
per-source column comparison.
:::
